Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Anil - 40 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Pihu - 10 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sunita, Anil and Pihu stand near him.]

Anil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Flower petals rain down on Kunal.]

Anil: "That's easy."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Sunita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Anil: "Really?"

[Kunal lights a bonfire.]

Kunal: "I really enjoyed today."
